description: SW2D-GPU provides a two-dimensional shallow-water solver implemented in CUDA C/C++ for NVIDIA graphics processors. LabHidro publishes the repository with Windows and Linux material and examples of Peri Lake watershed flow and dam-break simulation. Its describing article applies the model to urban inundation and lake water levels in Santa Catarina, Brazil, and includes evaporation in the formulation. Application area, simulation period and numerical resolution depend on the configured case; the software is not a fixed observation dataset. GitHub hosts the code, and the README requires a CUDA-compatible GPU and CUDA Toolkit 8.0 or later. The README permits code use with author citation and includes a liability disclaimer. This allows free use under custom terms, but a standard open-source licence was not identified. GPU compatibility and site-specific case preparation limit reuse. The model can support flood-hazard and reservoir-water-level studies. Related record model-hec-ras covers hydraulic modelling through another software system; no coupling was verified. The public article abstract and software-availability section were read, without obtaining the paywalled full article or downloading model files.
